name: ASMR Unboxing
_brand_source: brand/tokens/adel-v2.1.json — canvas, safe zones, watermark and motion come from the canonical export via scripts/brand_profile.py. No brand value is restated in this file.
_pipeline: 23_asmr_calibrate.py — real-footage validation: signature vs synthetic baseline, 9 diagnostics, gated tuning

platform_profiles._rule: Alternate formats RECOMPOSE. Never a centre-crop of the 9:16 master.

_analysis._note: A transient reserves pre_roll before and tail after it. Silence overlapping a reserve is never trimmed — the decay is the content.

creative._note: ASMR default is product-first, tactile, premium, calm — usually no creative treatment beyond the corner watermark. Renderer caps at one primary plus one supporting.

_status._note: Approved as an implementation milestone. NOT production-proven: detection thresholds were tuned on synthetic audio only. See docs/brand-os/16_PHASE2D_REALFOOTAGE_VALIDATION.md

_tuning_source: calibration/thresholds.json (via scripts/tuning.py) — detection constants, NOT brand values
